description.value:
You launch a glob of acid at a target within range. Make a ranged tech attack; on a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and another 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. A missed attack instead deals half the initial damage and no follow-up damage.

Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, both damage rolls increase by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
